policy: Only cards with verified image paths in the source wiki are copied. Cards 31-45 remain scheduled for later update.

cards.title: THIÊN ĐỒNG
cards.category: phuc tinh, hoa khi, tre tho noi tam.
cards.character: thien dong tu/child deity tre trung, ao ngoc nhat va bac.
cards.symbols: sen may, vien ngoc trang, dong song sao, cu chi ban phuc.
cards.colors: ngoc bich nhat, bac, xanh trang.
cards.light: vui song, nhan hau, duoc che cho.
cards.shadow: ham yen on, tranh trach nhiem.
cards.interpretation: Phuc tre, hoa khi, an nhien. Khi sang: vui song, nhan hau, duoc che cho. Khi lech: ham yen on, de tranh trach nhiem.
cards.quality_note: khong ve thanh vo tuong chien dau; the nay phai mem, trong, phuc hau.

cards.title: LỘC TỒN
cards.category: tai kho, loc duoc giu, nguon luc ben.
cards.character: nguoi giu kho troi, dignified keeper.
cards.symbols: kho vang, kho lua, dong tien co, lua gao, khoa ngoc, so sach.
cards.colors: vang am, luc tham, nau go.
cards.shadow: co chap, so mat, kho buong.
cards.interpretation: Loc duoc giu, cua tich tu, tai nguyen ben. Khi sang: biet giu phuc va tien. Khi lech: co chap, so mat, kho buong.
cards.quality_note: khong ve nhu tien roi hoang loan; Loc Ton la giu va khoa loc, khong phai phat tan.

cards.title: THAM LANG
cards.category: duc vong, tai nghe, dao hoa, hap luc.
cards.character: than sao soi cuon hut, ao luc bao va do tram.
cards.symbols: hoa dao, chen ruou, nhac cu, vuon dem, chom sao soi.
cards.colors: luc bao, do ruou, vang ho phach.
cards.light: giao te, sang tao, khai pha.
cards.shadow: tham cau, phong tung, nghien huong thu.
cards.interpretation: Duc vong, tai nghe, dao hoa, suc hut. Khi sang: giao te, sang tao, khai pha. Khi lech: tham cau, phong tung, nghien huong thu.
cards.quality_note: quyen ru nhung dignified; khong bien thanh ac quy hay nhan vat toi tam.

cards.title: TỬ VI
cards.category: de tinh, trung tam, chu quyen.
cards.character: de vuong sao tim ngoi truoc bac thien cung.
cards.symbols: hao quang Bac Cuc/Polaris, vuong mien tim vang, ngai may rong, ban do thien van.
cards.colors: tim de vuong, vang, den indigo.
cards.light: lanh dao, dieu phoi, pham vi.
cards.shadow: co cao, thich kiem soat, xa nguoi.
cards.interpretation: De tinh, trung tam, chu quyen. Khi sang: lanh dao, dieu phoi, pham vi. Khi lech: co cao, thich kiem soat, xa nguoi.
cards.quality_note: khong ve nhu chien tuong; Tu Vi la trung tam triều nghi va quyen uy tinh.

cards.title: THIÊN PHỦ
cards.category: kho troi, quan tri, hau thuan.
cards.character: quan phu/tro thu thien dinh trong kho cung.
cards.symbols: ruong ngoc, chia khoa dong, sach cuon, ban do dien san, ke sang ngay ngan.
cards.colors: xanh tram, vang co, ngoc.
cards.light: on dinh, biet chua va phan phoi.
cards.interpretation: Kho troi, quan tri, hau thuan. Khi sang: on dinh, biet chua va phan phoi. Khi lech: thu the, cham doi moi.
cards.quality_note: Thien Phu la quan tri nguon luc, khac Loc Ton la giu loc/khoa loc.

cards.title: THÁI DƯƠNG
cards.category: duong quang, danh du, hanh dong, phu he.
cards.character: than mat troi ao do vang.
cards.symbols: dia mat troi sau dau, may binh minh, nui duoc chieu sang, ban tay phat quang.
cards.colors: vang kim, do son, cam binh minh.
cards.light: chinh truc, soi duong, cong khai.
cards.shadow: hao luc, nong voi, kho nghi.
cards.interpretation: Duong quang, danh du, hanh dong. Khi sang: chinh truc, soi duong, cong khai. Khi lech: hao luc, nong voi, kho nghi.
cards.quality_note: phai sang, mo, huong ngoai; khong ve am u.

cards.title: THÁI ÂM
cards.category: am quang, noi tam, ky uc, tai san am.
cards.character: nu than mat trang ao trang ngoc/bac xanh.
cards.symbols: trang tron, ho nuoc phan chieu, tho bac, sen dem, ngoc trai.
cards.colors: trang ngoc, bac, xanh dem.
cards.light: tinh te, nuoi duong, sau sac.
cards.shadow: u sau, giau kin, do du.
cards.interpretation: Am quang, noi tam, ky uc, tai san am. Khi sang: tinh te, nuoi duong, sau sac. Khi lech: u sau, giau kin, do du.
cards.quality_note: Thai Am la anh sang phan chieu va nuoi duong; khong ve thanh lanh bang vo cam.

cards.title: THIÊN CƠ KỴ
cards.category: co troi bi nghen, muu luoc roi, tri tinh qua muc.
cards.character: quan su thien van, ao xanh den, dang lo nhung van dignified.
cards.symbols: thien nghi/astrolabe, banh rang bi ket, khoi muc den, sach cuon roi, la ban vo, dau sao xanh den.
cards.colors: xanh den, muc den, dong co, do canh bao nhe.
cards.light: thay loi trong he thong, bat diem mu.
cards.shadow: lo au, doi y, mac ket trong ke hoach.
cards.interpretation: Co troi bi nghen, tri tinh qua muc. Khi sang: thay loi trong he thong. Khi lech: lo au, doi y, mac ket trong ke hoach.
cards.quality_note: phai la tri tue bi nghen, khong phai nguoi ac; can QA ky chu "KỴ" vi AI de ve sai thanh "KÝ".

cards.title: KHÔNG KIẾP
cards.category: song sat, rong hoa, dut gay, dai bien.
cards.character: cap than rong va kiep, trang trong khong kinh di.
cards.symbols: hao quang sao den rong, sao choi do nut, cau gay, den tho tan vao hu khong, bau troi rach.
cards.colors: den rong, do sao choi, tim tham, bac lanh.
cards.light: pha ao tuong, tai sinh manh.
cards.shadow: mat mat, cuc doan, bien co bat ngo.
cards.interpretation: Rong hoa, dut gay, dai bien. Khi sang: pha ao tuong, tai sinh manh. Khi lech: mat mat, cuc doan, bien co bat ngo.
cards.quality_note: khong ve gore/kinh di; nang luong la pha cau truc va tai sinh.

cards.title: ĐẠI VẬN KIẾM ĐỒ
cards.category: hanh trinh dai van, chien luoc 10 nam, Founder cam kiem.
cards.character: Founder archetype, ao xanh dem va vang, cam kiem nghi le.
cards.symbols: con duong tinh tu, ba cong van "25-34", "35-44", "45-54"; cong ngoc binh minh, cong lua vang, cong sao tim.
cards.colors: xanh dem, vang kiem, ngoc, tim sao.
cards.meaning: cat me, qua cong, chon chien luoc dung thoi.
cards.interpretation: Duong kiem qua dai van. Cat me, qua cong, chon chien luoc dung thoi.
cards.quality_note: day la the hanh trinh, khong phai chien dau voi quai; kiem la su sang suot va quyet dinh.

cards.title: KẾT TÂM AN
cards.category: quy tam, an dinh, la so thanh vong ho phap.
cards.character: Founder dung giua la so, tay dat tai tam.
cards.symbols: la so Tu Vi dang mandala 12 cung, cac than tinh tu hoa thanh vong ho phap, hao quang vang bac.
cards.colors: vang trang, bac, xanh den, ngoc.
cards.meaning: noi tam ket lai thi tinh tu bien thanh luc bao ho.
cards.interpretation: Tam an giua la so. Khi noi tam ket lai, tinh tu hoa vong ho phap.
cards.quality_note: trang thai tinh lang, khong ve thanh tran phap chien dau.

cards.title: TẢ PHÙ - HỮU BẬT
cards.category: song quy nhan, doi ngu, nguoi tro luc.
cards.character: hai ho phap quan van dung hai ben.
cards.symbols: gay ngoc, sach cuon, an vang, den long, hai ban tay ho tro tao thanh chom sao.
cards.colors: ngoc, vang, xanh tham.
cards.meaning: doi ngu dung nguoi giup viec lon thanh hinh.
cards.interpretation: Song quy nhan tro luc. Doi ngu dung nguoi giup viec lon thanh hinh.
cards.quality_note: khong ve cap doi tinh cam; day la tro luc/he sinh thai dong minh.

cards.title: VĂN XƯƠNG - VĂN KHÚC
cards.category: cap van tinh, tri tue, hoc thuat, danh tieng.
cards.character: hai van tinh ao hoc gia; mot viet thu phap, mot choi nhac cu.
cards.symbols: but sang, muc nghien, sach cuon, thu vien duoi trang, hac, dong tho bang sao.
cards.colors: ivory, xanh hoc gia, vang nhe, bac trang.
cards.meaning: chu nghia, hoc thuat va danh tieng duoc mai thanh anh sang.
cards.interpretation: Cap van tinh khai tri. Hoc thuat, chu nghia, danh tieng duoc mai thanh anh sang.
cards.quality_note: khong ve nhu chien thuat; nang luong la van, nhac, tri tue va thanh danh.

cards.title: CỰ MÔN
cards.category: khau chien, thi phi, tranh bien, cua ngon tu.
cards.character: phap su ngon tu/nguoi giu cong tranh bien.
cards.symbols: cong dong hinh an mieng co, gay phat ngon den vang, sach cuon, phu chu loi noi, can cong ly, may muc.
cards.colors: den vang, dong co, xanh muc.
cards.meaning: loi noi mo cua nhung cung co the thanh luoi dao.
cards.interpretation: Than khau chien va thi phi. Loi noi mo cua, cung co the thanh luoi dao.
cards.quality_note: khong bien Cu Mon thanh ac ma; phai co chat kiem chung chan ly, cong tranh bien.

cards.title: LIÊM TRINH + HỎA TINH
cards.category: vo tuong lua, xung dot gia dao/con cai/du an moi.
cards.character: vo tuong ao giap nghi le do den, cam thuong lua.
cards.symbols: sao choi do, lua ren, nha tho to/gia dao, co du an moi, tia lua ky luat.
cards.colors: do lua, den, vang nong.
cards.meaning: xung dot bung len de thu long, ren ky luat va du an moi.
cards.interpretation: Vo tuong lua. Xung dot bung len de thu long, ren ky luat va du an moi.
cards.quality_note: tranh gore; day la lua xung dot va ky luat, khong phai thiet huyet vo nghia.

cards.title: PHÁ QUÂN
cards.category: chien than pha cu lap moi, dao han, bien dong lon.
cards.character: chien than cao quy cua su tai tao.
cards.symbols: thanh cu sup do, thanh moi moc len, xich vo, co rach hoa thanh lua sao/phuong hoang, chien dao ha xuong.
cards.colors: do sao, vang chay, den khoi, xanh dem.
cards.meaning: nguoi dam buong cai cu se mo duoc duong moi.
cards.interpretation: Pha cu lap moi. Khi han dao chieu, nguoi dam buong se mo duoc duong moi.
cards.quality_note: khong ve pha hoai vo nghia; Phá Quân phai co mot cong trinh moi dang len.

cards.title: KÌNH DƯƠNG - ĐÀ LA
cards.category: sat khi, binh khi sac ben va tri tre, va cham, anh em, cap tren.
cards.character: hai ho phap binh khi doi dien trong ai tinh tu.
cards.symbols: Kinh Duong la chien binh thuong luoi bac sac; Da La la ho phap day/moc/canh xe gai, chuyen dong cham; duong nut, chi do canh bao, an cap tren, co anh em.
cards.colors: bac sac, den gai, do canh bao, vang co.
cards.meaning: sac ben va tri keo; canh bao va cham, loi cung, anh em va cap tren.
cards.interpretation: Sac ben va tri keo. Canh bao va cham, loi cung, anh em va cap tren.
cards.quality_note: Kinh la dot ngot/sac; Da La la cham/keo/ket. Phai co hai nang luong trai nhau.

cards.title: HỒNG LOAN - THIÊN HỈ
cards.category: duyen tinh, hy khi, tinh cam, nu quy nhan.
cards.character: hai nu than phuc tinh mem mai.
cards.symbols: day to hong, hoa mau don, den hy vang, quat nghi le, vuon trang, cap chim, hao quang hong vang.
cards.colors: hong dao, ivory, vang mem, bac trang.
cards.meaning: tinh cam va nu quy nhan lam mem van cung.
cards.interpretation: Duyen tinh va hy khi. Tinh cam, nu quy nhan va niem vui lam mem van cung.
cards.quality_note: phai mem va sang; khong bien thanh the hon le qua hien dai hay sexy.

cards.title: ĐẨU QUÂN
cards.category: truc so menh, chu diem sinh, nguoi giu an menh.
cards.character: nguoi giu truc so menh, dung giua la so, than thai nghiem va tinh.
cards.symbols: Bac Dau that tinh trong tay, an menh, truc doc xuyen qua la so, vong 12 cung, kham troi son son thep vang.
cards.colors: xanh den, vang bac dau, tim tram, dong co.
cards.meaning: diem neo cua menh cuc, noi gio sinh ket thanh ban do doi nguoi.
cards.interpretation: Nguoi giu truc so menh. Gio sinh ket lai, Bac Dau dong an len ban do doi nguoi.
cards.quality_note: khac Tu Vi; Dau Quan khong phai de vuong ma la nguoi giu truc/giu an cua la so.

cards.title: CÔ THẦN
cards.category: co doc noi tam, chieu sau tu tinh, mệnh co don.
cards.character: kiem khach co doc duoi trang, ao toi, dung tren duong nui hoac san den vang.
cards.symbols: trang khuyet, kiem trong vo, bong dai, mot ngon den xa, la so mo nhat sau lung.
cards.colors: xanh dem, bac trang, den muc, vang rat nhe.
cards.meaning: su don doc lam sau noi tam va ren ban linh.
cards.interpretation: Kiem khach duoi trang. Co doc khong phai het duong, ma la loi vao chieu sau noi tam.
cards.quality_note: khong ve nhu sat tinh bao luc; Co Than la tinh lang va tu chu.

cards.title: QUẢ TÚ
cards.category: co doc tinh cam, bong le, nhan duyen muon.
cards.character: nhan vat ao toi giu hoa tan hoac den le, gioi tinh co the trung tinh.
cards.symbols: hoa tan, den le, khung cua rong, vuon vang, day to hong dut nhe.
cards.colors: tim than, xam bac, hong phai, vang nen.
cards.meaning: khoang trong tinh cam day nguoi ta hoc cach tu nuoi duong.
cards.interpretation: Den le giua vuon vang. Tinh cam vang bong de trai tim hoc cach tu sang.
cards.quality_note: di cap y nghia voi Co Than nhung mem hon, nghieng ve tinh cam/duyen.

cards.title: THIÊN VIỆT
cards.category: quy nhan tinh, cuu nguy, phu lenh tro giup.
cards.character: su gia troi/dao nhan ao trang trao phu lenh.
cards.symbols: phu lenh vang, may trang, chim hac, cau anh sang, ban tay cuu nguy, den tho Viet.
cards.colors: trang nga, vang thanh, xanh troi nhat, bac.
cards.meaning: quy nhan xuat hien dung luc de mo loi thoat.
cards.interpretation: Phu lenh cuu nguy. Khi menh gap canh hep, quy nhan mo mot loi sang.
cards.quality_note: Thien Viet la cuu tro dung luc, khong phai doi ngu thuong truc nhu Ta Phu - Huu Bat.

cards.title: THIÊN TƯỚNG
cards.category: cong minh, phap do, quan tri doi ngu va quyen luc.
cards.character: dai tuong giu phap do, ao giap nghi le, mat nghiem nhung chinh truc.
cards.symbols: can cong ly, an lenh, co tuong, doanh trai co trat tu, khiem/phap phu.
cards.colors: xanh than, vang lenh, bac thep, do tram.
cards.meaning: giu can bang giua nguoi, viec va quyen luc.
cards.interpretation: Dai tuong giu phap do. Doi ngu manh khi quyen luc duoc can bang bang cong minh.
cards.quality_note: khac Phá Quân va Thất Sát; Thiên Tướng khong pha, khong sat, ma giu luat va giu the.

cards.title: VŨ KHÚC
cards.category: menh chu, y chi, tai chinh, kim khi.
cards.character: vo than Kim, lanh va chac, cam dao/kiem va ban tinh vang.
cards.symbols: kim loai, tien vang, ban tinh, kho vu khi, sao trang kim, ao giap bac vang.
cards.colors: bac thep, vang kim, den than, xanh luc tram.
cards.meaning: y chi bien ky luat thanh tai chinh va luc hanh dong.
cards.interpretation: Vo than Kim. Y chi sac nhu luoi kiem, tai chinh ben nhu kim thach.
cards.quality_note: khac Loc Ton; Vu Khuc la kiem tien/hanh dong/ky luat tai chinh, Loc Ton la giu loc.

cards.title: LINH TINH
cards.category: sat tinh ngam, bat man doi ngu, lua am.
cards.character: ngon lua am i trong doanh trai, co the co mot linh canh im lang.
cards.symbols: than hong duoi tro, doanh trai dem, bong nguoi bat man, tia lua xanh do, trong tran phu bui.
cards.colors: do than, cam toi, xanh den, den khoi.
cards.meaning: viec nho bi nen lau ngay co the thanh chay ngam trong tap the.
cards.interpretation: Lua am trong doanh trai. Bat man nho neu khong duoc soi ro se thanh bien dong ngam.
cards.quality_note: khac Hỏa Tinh bung no; Linh Tinh la lua ngam, am i, kho thay.

cards.title: THIÊN KHỐC
cards.category: buon nen, khoc tham, cam xuc tuyen Tu Tuc.
cards.character: nhan vat dung trong mua, om chuong nho hoac chuong tang nho.
cards.symbols: mua dem, chuong nho, manh vai trang, sen uot, khung cua dong, sao le.
cards.colors: xam mua, xanh lanh, bac, trang duc.
cards.meaning: noi buon bi nen can duoc nghe thay truoc khi hoa thanh khoang cach.
cards.interpretation: Chuong nho trong mua. Noi buon bi nen can duoc lang nghe de khong hoa thanh xa cach.
cards.quality_note: khong ve tang toc nang ne; thẻ này la buon tham va giai toa cam xuc.

cards.title: TAM THAI
cards.category: sao bo tro nho, nang do, phu the/nhan duyen.
cards.character: be tam cap hoac dai sen nang mot vong duyen, co the co ba bac anh sang.
cards.symbols: ba bac da, dai sen, den nho, hai day duyen duoc nang len, may lanh.
cards.colors: ngoc nhat, vang nhe, trang sen, xanh troi.
cards.meaning: luc nang do am tham giup quan he dung vao vi tri tot hon.
cards.interpretation: Be tam cap nang duyen. Tro luc nho nhung dung luc co the nang mot moi quan he.
cards.quality_note: khong qua quyen luc; Tam Thai la nang do nhe, khong phai de tinh hay dai quy nhan.

cards.title: THẤT SÁT
cards.category: sat khi manh, ap luc, quyet doan, chien tuong lanh.
cards.character: chien tuong lanh, ao giap toi, kiem den, mat tinh va khong nao dong.
cards.symbols: bay sao sac, kiem den, bien ai lanh, co chien rach, mat dat bang gia.
cards.colors: den thep, xanh lanh, bac sat, do tram rat it.
cards.meaning: ap luc lon ep nguoi ta cat bo do du va ra quyet dinh.
cards.interpretation: Chien tuong lanh. Ap luc lon khong hoi long nguoi, no doi mot quyet dinh ro rang.
cards.quality_note: khac Phá Quân; Thất Sát la quyet sat/chien luc, Phá Quân la pha cu lap moi.

cards.title: ĐỊA KHÔNG
cards.category: khong tinh, vuc rong, mat nen, khoang trong bat ngo.
cards.character: khong can nhan vat hoac mot nguoi nho dung truoc vuc rong.
cards.symbols: vuc den rong, nen dat nut roi bien mat, cua khong, sao den, la so bi khuyet mot cung.
cards.colors: den rong, xanh tham, bac lanh, vang rat mong.
cards.meaning: nen cu bien mat de lo ra khoang rong can doi dien.
cards.interpretation: Vuc rong duoi chan. Khi nen cu bien mat, su that ve bam chap hien ra.
cards.quality_note: Dia Khong la rong/mat nen, khac Dia Kiep la tai bien/vo vat chat.

cards.title: ĐỊA KIẾP
cards.category: tai kiep, do vo vat chat, bien co sac.
cards.character: than tai kiep voi ao choang do den, dung giua do vo nhung khong kinh di.
cards.symbols: dao phong, mai ngo vo, cau gay, sao choi do, vat dung roi, bui lua.
cards.colors: do sat, den khoi, vang lua, xam da.
cards.meaning: bien co vat chat cat ngang dong chay cu, buoc nguoi ta tinh lai.
cards.interpretation: Dao phong qua dat. Bien co vat chat cat ngang dong cu, buoc ta tinh lai.
cards.quality_note: Dia Kiep la tai bien va do vo ro net; khong trung voi Không Kiếp tổng hợp hay Địa Không rong hoa.
